Name: More Ice Cream - Unique Villager Flavours
Author: strawhatwem
Description:
[b][size=5]Info [/size][/b]

This mod adds a unique flavour of ice cream for each vanilla villager. These are not included in the shipping progress for Perfection. 

They will be sold through Alex's ice cream stand during summer, and only after obtaining 4 hearts with each respective villager. 

[b]The exceptions are the Wizard, Krobus, and Dwarf. [/b]Krobus and Dwarf sell their own ice creams after you reach 4 hearts with them. The Wizard's ice cream will be available at 6 Hearts and will be sold by the Raccoon shop, [b]after you finish the whole questline.[/b] The Wizard will also send you ice cream at a specific point in time. 

Summer birthdays will also have respective ice creams sold, regardless of heart level.

The default ice cream selection will also be expanded [b]after completing the new Special Order.[/b] These flavours will be in the shop all summer. 

Each villager loves their flavour. All the other flavours will be liked, except for a few. That's for you to find out. 

If you have a better name for a flavour, let me know. I might not change it, but it would be fun to see what you come up with! If I do change it, I'll credit you in this description. 

[b][size=5]Recipes[/size][/b]
Recipes are now available. They must be turned on via the config option. The conditions are the same as the ice creams themselves. 

Two ice cream flavours (Chocolate and Mint Chocolate Chip) require Cornucopia. 

[b][size=5]Translation[/size][/b]
This mod supports i18n. Please message me if you'd like to translate. Given that I made many of these names funky, I hope anyone playing with a translation will enjoy the translations each author came up with! ^0^
